description: Tandlianwala Sugar Mills Limited started in 1992 as a single sugar mill and now operates as a group of three sugar mills, two ethanol distilleries and a carbon dioxide plant. Unit 1 at Kanjwani, Tandlianwala in Faisalabad district produces sugar, ethanol and CO2; Unit 2 at Zamand on the Indus Highway in Dera Ismail Khan and Unit 3 at Rehman Hajra in Muzaffargarh produce sugar, the third also with ethanol.
